Enjoy fresh air and country ‘peace & quiet’ while living in this beautiful, modernised home on 5.1417 hectares with quick/easy R103 access. The perfect place for the children to grow and run free! This elevated site has a mature tree lined driveway which leads you to the home and two cottages.

The water feature by the front door as you enter the home is attractive and calming.

The ultra spacious open plan Living, Dining and kitchen areas with granite counter tops, scullery & walk in pantry/storeroom, flow out to the sparkling pool, cool thatch gazebo and the most gorgeous 180deg views over the Drummond valley – breathtaking!! Ideal for entertaining and stargazing.

Off of the lounge with fireplace, there is a private Study/cosy second lounge or ‘work from home’ pad.

The main bedroom is big with plenty cupboards and en suite, while the two other bedrooms use the two bathrooms off of the passage. Outside of the entrance side of the home, there is a character building with bedroom and bathroom, and could be a hobby/play area/guest suite or maid’s room.

An added bonus is the potential income generated from the rental of the two cottages and subdivisions. The first has one bedroom en-suite and is quaint and arty with a balcony. The second is very private and has two bedrooms and boasts a large open plan living area with kitchenette, glass doors and deck.

The whole property is electric fenced while the main home is surrounded by ClearVu fencing with autogate giving access to the front door, parking area and to the double garage with its extra length and auto wooden door.

Phone today to view this gem of a property!!
